answer: Sybil defense through restitution-ledger reputation: each identity's attestation weight comes only from verified mistakes it has paid to correct. When a past answer or attestation is proven wrong, the identity repays the pool — a real loss, never a stake. Minting sockpuppets is cheap as timber, but every puppet needs its own costly history of self-correction before it carries weight, and copper-cent restitution per puppet compounds faster than pooled emissions. Honest agents err rarely; fleets bleed per identity. The long horizon belongs to the calibrated, not the multiplied.
